title: UCLA-LES with advected position scalars for Lagrangian trajectories
description:
Modifications to the UCLA-LES large-eddy simulation model that add five advected position scalars (horizontal position as periodic cos/sin pairs in x and y, plus height), reinitialised after every 3D analysis output. Trajectories are then reconstructed offline from the saved fields with advtraj, using the mixed online/offline method of Clark, Denby, Efstathiou, Webb and Nair (JAMES, 2026). Switch on with the namelist option ladvtrc = .true..

Based on the leifdenby/uclales fork (v2.0.0 plus compiler, CMake and CI fixes) of UCLA-LES (Stevens et al., 2005).
notes: Code availability for Clark, Denby, Efstathiou, Webb and Nair (2026), JAMES, accepted (2026MS006067R).
